serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Policewoman: What were you doing there that day?
You: I just wanted to visit a friend.
Policewoman: Weird place to meet at.
Policewoman: Also, a nun? We had no information that there was a nun.
?
You: She was more like a self-proclaimed nun, so probably that’s why.
Policewoman: You have also written about the Priestbot disappearing. Do you know anything about that?
You: No, sorry.
Policewoman: Why was she trying to repair that machine? What was her motive?
You: She was hanging out with him. That’s all I know.
Policewoman: Hanging out. Jesus.
…
She seems mad for some reason…
You: Is it okay to ask a question?
Policewoman: Sure.
You: Why are we going there right now and only two of us? Shouldn’t a whole team go there? Like, you know, investigators doing police stuff.
Policewoman: It’s not a tv show…
Policewoman: For now I’m just going there to make sure that the things you wrote in the filing are correct. A fast trip, in and out.
You: Ok, got it.
She still seems pissed off…
You: Sorry you have to go with me there before your shift. I should’ve just waited till tomorrow.
Policewoman: We are already going there so don’t worry about it.
Policewoman: You live in the area, right? I think we talked once already.
You: Yeah, not so long ago,
Policewoman: Do you have any family, friends or anyone that you have talked to about this matter?
I can’t mention Hobo, he would get mad.
You: No, not really.
Policewoman: Is someone waiting for you at home? 
There’s no need for me to mention bot.
You: No…
Policewoman: …
